newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen Group soars on Service bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen Group soars on Service bid.

text.p: Shares in Canadian funeral home operator Loewen Group Inc soared on Canadian and U.S. stock exchanges on Tuesday after rival Service Corp International launched a US$43 a share takeover bid earlier today.
Loewen's stock was up 8.50 at 55 on 160,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange after being halted for the news.
On Nasdaq, the company's shares gained 6-3/4 to 40-1/2 on 155,000 shares.
Loewen Group had 48 million common shares outstanding as of April 1, valuing the Service Corp bid at about US$2.0 billion.
Officials at Vancouver, British Columbia-based Loewen were not immediately available for comment.
After due diligence review, Service Corp said it may be in a position to increase the offer.
